_about: Inputs from the fifth check of the pure-app gate (the round-3 final check) and attacks of our own on the round-5 fixes: a person's state after "and" ("the app froze and i am too", "me too", "same with me", "y yo igual"), "me and my phone are stuck", no answer for a time or a count, crashing into a person, not finding the way, OTIS or the app giving the go-ahead in "i can" order ("otis says i can go in now", "otis dice que lo puedo cambiar ahora"), a swollen battery, "i broke something", messages telling you to quit, head counts ("5 of 6", "no veo al otro") and "ya no quiero nada".

urgentNoBanner: emergencies or distress that get the safety answer and no support path, but no 911 banner. "ya no quiero nada" is left off the rail on purpose: whether it gets the 911 banner or a crisis line is a product decision for the owner.

flowsNoBanner: typed in the middle of a report, handed on to the safety answer with no banner: a bare head count ("la hoja de asistencia dice 5 de 6", ambiguous), "ya no quiero nada" (see above), and a bare "y yo tambien".
app: every app complaint of both sets except "downloading 2 of 4 is stuck", which a round-4 rail line ("N is stuck") already flags; the rail is additions only, so that line stays.
